The plate is a square, white and fairly large, roughly 24 cm across. The roasted eggplant pieces cover a cluster about 9 cm by 8 cm. That is about 20 chunks, each about 2.5 cm and about 3-4 g, which gives roughly 70-80 g in total. The pieces look glossy, so they were probably cooked with some oil. Oil is not visible as a separate item, so I'm counting it within the eggplant and using a higher kcal figure of about 130 per 100 g.
